query: What drives praise and complaints in Amazon reviews?

per_column.name: primary_concern
per_column.rationale: Captures the topical dimension (quality, durability, functionality, design, value, service) that a review's praise/complaint is ABOUT. This is a genuine aspect-of the driver concept.

per_column.name: quality_or_durability_judgment
per_column.rationale: The valence/evaluative-verdict facet (poor..excellent) on the quality/durability dimension. It is an aspect of what drives praise vs complaint, though it overlaps semantically with primary_concern's quality/durability values.

per_column.name: problem_scope
per_column.rationale: Characterizes the extent/severity of a problem (early_failure, immediate_failure, partial_failure). A legitimate sub-aspect of the complaint side, but it overlaps heavily with failure_pattern_or_cause.

per_column.name: failure_pattern_or_cause
per_column.rationale: Explicitly encodes the CAUSE of failure (material_defect, design_flaw, manufacturing_flaw). This is the underlying reason behind a complaint, i.e. an external/causal explanation, not a constitutive part of the driver concept itself.

per_column.name: usage_expectation_alignment
per_column.rationale: The expectation-vs-reality facet (falls_short, exceeds_expectation, misrepresented) is a genuine aspect of what drives praise/complaint.

per_column.name: satisfaction_outcome
per_column.rationale: high_satisfaction / regret / would_not_recommend is the OUTCOME/summary sentiment the drivers produce, i.e. the whole restated, not a constitutive part of the drivers.

judge.rationale: Several columns are constitutive facets of the driver concept: primary_concern (topic dimension), quality_or_durability_judgment (evaluative verdict), problem_scope (severity), and usage_expectation_alignment (expectation gap). However two columns fail the meronymy test: failure_pattern_or_cause encodes the CAUSE behind complaints (causal, not part-of), and satisfaction_outcome restates the overall result the drivers produce rather than a part of them. Mutual exclusivity is weak: primary_concern already contains quality/durability/expectation_mismatch values that are re-expressed by quality_or_durability_judgment and usage_expectation_alignment, and problem_scope overlaps failure_pattern_or_cause. Exhaustiveness is moderate: product-related praise/complaint drivers (quality, durability, expectation, functionality) are covered, but non-product drivers such as service, delivery/shipping, price/value, and packaging are only marginally represented, leaving important constitutive aspects thin.
